core_meaning.primary_meaning: Elias is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “An. The source record”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Elias corresponds to the Hebrew form إلياس (Hebrew אֵלִיָּהוּ). Its core sense is my god is the lord. Ilyās, the Arabic form of Elijah, a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'My God is the Lord' is a reasonable rendering.
